nodes.description: Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the sender.
Internal whitelist gate allowing owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale addresses to bypass the sale condition.
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance/balance bookkeeping and calling ensure before moving balances.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal sale-limit check using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and payload.
Owner-only initialiser setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution looping over _tos and mutating balances with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure.
Constructor setting metadata, totalSupply, owner, balances and an unlimited UNI allowance.
Private owner address used as the privileged whitelist and access-control anchor.
Address exempted from the sale condition inside ensure.
Public mapping of account balances.
Public nested mapping of allowances.
Per-address counter of completed sales used by condition.
Private mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass sale conditions.
Minimum transfer amount accepted by condition.
Maximum transfer amount accepted by condition.
Maximum number of sales per address before condition rejects.
Public total token supply.
Constant 18 decimals used for scaling in init and constructor.
Public token name.
Public token symbol.
Caller-controlled address used for access control, approvals and transfer origination.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata, executing foreign code in this contract storage context.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length and _value/2 divisions without SafeMath.
uint(-1) cast in the constructor granting the maximum possible allowance.
Transfer amount parameter used by transfer, transferFrom and condition.
Source account parameter of transferFrom and ensure.
Recipient parameter of transfer.
Spender parameter of approve.
Recipient array parameter of batchSend.
Attacker-influenced delegatecall target address in delegate.
Attacker-influenced delegatecall calldata in delegate.
Sale count argument written to _saleNum in init.
Minimum sale argument written to _minSale in init.
Maximum sale argument written to _maxSale in init.
Address argument written to tradeAddress in setTradeAddress.
Local batch total computed from the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Loop index iterating over _tos in batchSend.
Locally derived Uniswap pair address compared against _from in ensure.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the sender of the transfer via _msgSender.
msg.sender is checked against allowance as the spender in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing an arbitrary delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner to configure sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass balance changes.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner to set the whitelisted trade address.
constructor assigns msg.sender as owner and initial holder.
_value amount is forwarded to transferFrom by transfer.
_value is used for allowance and balance subtraction in transferFrom.
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
_from is the debited account in transferFrom.
_from is compared against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure.
_to is used as the recipient in transfer.
_spender is written into the allowance mapping in approve.
_tos array elements are credited inside the batchSend loop.
_tos.length participates in the unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
caller-supplied address a is the delegatecall target in delegate.
caller-supplied bytes b is the delegatecall payload in delegate.
Attacker-influenced address a flows directly into the delegatecall target.
Attacker-influenced calldata b flows directly into the delegatecall payload.
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init.
token is scaled and stored into _minSale by init.
maxToken is scaled and stored into _maxSale by init.
addr is written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
local total originates from an unchecked multiplication used to debit msg.sender.
loop index i controls the iteration over _tos in batchSend.
_UNI derived by pairFor is compared against _from in ensure.
transfer calls transferFrom to perform the actual state change.
transferFrom reverts unless ensure returns true.
ensure calls condition for accounts outside the whitelist.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address for whitelisting.
delegate executes the low-level delegatecall after the owner check.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
constructor writes allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1).
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom debits and credits balanceOf.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each sale.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner to bypass the sale condition.
ensure compares _from against the whitelisted tradeAddress.
ensure checks canSale[_from] to whitelist an arbitrary address.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition reads _minSale for the minimum amount check.
condition reads _maxSale for the maximum amount check.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
batchSend modifies balanceOf for msg.sender and every recipient.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
constructor sets owner to msg.sender.
constructor sets the initial balanceOf of msg.sender.
constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the UNI router.
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
constructor sets the token name.
constructor sets the token symbol.
delegate gates the delegatecall on msg.sender == owner.
delegatecall runs arbitrary external code in this storage context, which can overwrite owner and re-enter privileged state-changing functions.

normalization_plan.reason: _value is only a transfer amount flowing into transferFrom/transfer and needs no standalone node beyond its owning function.
_from is the debited account argument consumed only by transferFrom and ensure.
_to is the recipient argument consumed only by transfer.
_spender is the allowance target argument consumed only by approve.
_tos is the recipient array argument consumed only by batchSend.
a is the delegatecall target supplied to delegate.
b is the delegatecall payload supplied to delegate.
saleNum is a configuration argument written to _saleNum by init.
token is a configuration argument written to _minSale by init.
maxToken is a configuration argument written to _maxSale by init.
addr is the only argument of setTradeAddress and is stored in tradeAddress.
total is the intermediate batch amount computed inside batchSend.
i is the loop counter local to batchSend.
_UNI is a locally derived pair address used only inside ensure.
